source_review.title: Omega-3 fatty acids and cardiovascular outcomes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
source_review.journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology

conclusion_summary: Omega-3 supplementation shows mixed results for cardiovascular outcomes; REDUCE-IT showed benefit with high-dose EPA but other trials were neutral.
limitations: Varying EPA:DHA ratios not consistently reported
Population differences in baseline omega-3 intake
